ICE_PRICE_CHECK.type: Secondary historical market-data search snapshot; later full open rate-limited

peers.peer_role: Core, with investment and collateral-interest comparability caveats
peers.normalization_note: Main EBIT is GAAP. SBC, acquired amortization, restructuring, legal, strategic transaction costs and deferred compensation remain expensed; no generic adjusted-earnings addbacks.

capital.additional_operating_cash_reserve_basis: Assumption for comparable accounting EV only, not proof all unrestricted cash is distributable. DCO/DCM capital and liquidity requirements remain; quantified total excess capital not independently established.
capital.note: Do not use headline $2.4bn cash: it includes $225m FICC deposit in other current assets. Exclude $131m marketable securities conservatively because fair-value table includes deferred-compensation-linked investments; no additional value assigned to strategic stakes. Debt is carrying value, not face or fair value. No operating lease liability capitalized because EBIT includes rent. $44.0m finance lease liability is separately added as financing debt.

earnings_caveats: FY2025 includes $306.1m gain on OSTTRA sale in investment income (10-K); this survives in current TTM GAAP P/E. No estimated tax-normalized P/E is presented.

CME reports net collateral interest and equity-method earnings below operating income. EV includes strategic investment value but EBIT excludes its earnings, so EV/EBIT is a group-level screening multiple, not pure fee-business EV/EBIT.
4.584m preferred shares converted to common on March 5, 2026. Q3 diluted share proxy and dated cover-page outstanding shares are separate inputs.

peers.peer_role: Secondary: exchanges plus fixed income/data and mortgage technology; pending MarketAxess
peers.normalization_note: Main EBIT is GAAP. SBC, acquired amortization and transaction/integration costs remain expensed; no general non-GAAP addbacks. Supplemental EBITDA is mechanical GAAP EBIT plus separately disclosed D&A, not normalized earnings.

capital.pass_through_reserve_basis: Section 31 fees payable: 10-Q states collections enter cash and are remitted twice annually. Reserve this cash rather than treat it as available to equity.
capital.prefunding_offset_basis: 10-Q Note 8 discloses $3.7bn net proceeds from August senior notes separately invested in short-term restricted cash; rounded source amount. Not distributable, not regulatory/client cash. Shown only as a separate matched-funding sensitivity, not subtracted from primary restricted-cash-excluding EV.
capital.additional_operating_cash_reserve_basis: Assumption for comparable accounting EV only, not proof of distributability. Regulatory and own guaranty-fund/SITG cash and investments remain invested and are not excess cash.
capital.note: Book NCI and redeemable NCI included in EV; no market-value estimate. No operating lease debt addition because EBIT retains rent. Debt balance includes acquisition prefunding; standalone denominators exclude MarketAxess.

earnings_caveats: YTD2026 net income includes $452m fair-value investment gains versus $35m YTD2025. GAAP P/E is not a normalized earnings multiple.
OTC/Other revenue includes net interest income/fees on clearing collateral, not separately quantified here; treatment differs from CME below-operating-income presentation.
Mortgage technology acquisition amortization is material and retained; this intentionally avoids applying management adjusted EBIT on an inconsistent basis.

Strategic equity/equity-method investments of $2,994m book value are not deducted from EV because carrying value is not fair value. Their nonoperating contribution creates a numerator-denominator scope mismatch.

post_balance_sheet_event.description: MarketAxess shareholders approved the merger agreement. Closing still expected Q1 2027, subject to remaining customary conditions and other regulatory approvals. Not completed as of valuation date.

reproduction.source_archive_policy: Source URLs and previously recorded archive hashes are provenance metadata. Full filings are not redistributed and are not required to reproduce the calculations.
